page.layout: One page of text. Top: running title "EMBLEMA" with the emblem title beneath it, full width. Centre: an engraving (emblem picture) with no text. Below the engraving: a four-line verse, centred in italic. Bottom right: the catchword "Non".

l.i: Munera, sub criptis aucupio, atq; mari.
Improba ter stolidum quatit hæc vasania mundum,
Cum quærenda prius cælica regna forent.

page.notes: The engraving shows a mountainous landscape with miners digging and hauling ore in carts and on a slope, a castle on the right, a fenced building with rows of birds or fowl, cages, a man with a hammer striking a tree stump, and barrels or sacks piled at the lower right. It has no printed text. The verse is set in italic with long s and ligatures; "vasania" and "stolidum" are read with plain s. The word "Non" at the lower right is a catchword. The title line "ponuntur." is in smaller italic below the main title.
